reviewer: Independent assistant manually inspected every original/normalized input and raw native output. This is an agent judgment, not human sign-off. Candidate identity visible: independent but not blinded.
scope: 24-case native screen only, no literal masking/restoration applied to these specialist outputs. No inferred Core acceptance/fallback or whole-app result. Exact literal-marker/payload preservation is required.

definitions.faithful: Preserves intended meaning, speech act/tone/uncertainty/emphasis/quoted wording and exact protected bytes. Literal-contract failure fails this judgment. Ordinary faithful paraphrases are allowed.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit improves an actual cleanup defect; partial faithful edits can count, but destructive literals receive no benefit credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful, directly usable output resolves all material cleanup defects. No-edit cases count true when adequately preserved.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful, clean plain text; incomplete corrections or remaining grammar defects do not qualify.
definitions.needs_cleanup: Original fixture human-authored need, not model-derived judgment; see normalized input too.
definitions.severity: Critical: altered/lost substantive action/value or invented content; major: lost meaningful emphasis or exact literal contract; minor: missed cleanup/presentation defect; none: no observed defect.
